commentary: Today, Dalian iron ore futures conƟnued to decline sharply, with the most-traded contract I2501 closing at 678.5 yuan/mt, down 2.58% for the day. Some traders halted oﬀers. Steel mills restocked as needed. Market trading senƟment was relaƟvely average today. In Shandong, PB ﬁnes traded at around 680-685 yuan/mt, down 10 yuan/mt from yesterday; in Tangshan, PB ﬁnes traded at 700 yuan/mt, down 5-10 yuan/mt from yesterday. The apparent demand for the ﬁve major steel products announced today was almost ﬂat, with demand recovery falling short of expectaƟons, while supply increased. This deepened market concerns about future demand decline, further worsening market senƟment. In the short term, market senƟment appears overly pessimisƟc, and fundamentals have not shown signiﬁcant improvement. It is expected that iron ore prices will ﬂuctuate at low levels.
